parsed.name: Hamilton 微孔板加热振荡器控制盒
parsed.description: 用于连接和控制 Hamilton 微孔板加热振荡器的控制盒，可执行加热、振荡、锁板/解锁并读取温度信息，常用于微孔板样品的孵育、混匀和自动化实验流程。
parsed.description_en: A control box for Hamilton microplate heater-shaker units, used to heat and shake plates, lock or release plates, and read temperature information. It is commonly used for plate incubation, mixing, and automated laboratory workflows.
